guides.title: Build and playstyle - Conquest Jungle
guides.notes: Your main goal is to blink and one shot their immobile mid or adc preferrably when they are alone. Don't forget that you can use your 2 after hitting your 3 without hitting a basic attack, do this only enemy player has very low health. Otherwise, the hitting order is as follows: blink, 3, basic, basic, (ult if they are knocked up), (2, if they are not knocked up). Do not forget to blink their back or side. Blinking into their faces puts you in a terrible stop. Your ult is a tower burner, use it.
